name: lanto
description: An open-source remote workspace for your computers.
author: Lanto contributors

scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts electron.vite.config.ts tsconfig*.json package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts electron.vite.config.ts tsconfig*.json package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.ts tests/*.test.mjs && npm run test:tunnel
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && npm run host:build && node scripts/build-tunnel.mjs && node scripts/build-deploy.mjs
